title: Website development in Camp Verde, AZ | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs builds websites, booking and quote tools, and web applications for Camp Verde businesses. Fixed price, quoted after a scoping call.
h1: Website and web application development in Camp Verde
intro: Camp Verde draws visitors to Montezuma Castle, Fort Verde, and the Verde River, and many of the town's restaurants, lodging, outfitters, and shops depend on being found online. Many small-business websites here were built on Wix, Squarespace, or WordPress and list hours and a phone number but offer no way to book, request a quote, or fill out a form. Contractors, farms, and service businesses in the area often have the same gap between the website and the work.

Creosote Labs builds websites and web applications for Camp Verde businesses, from a marketing site with clear services, pricing, and a way to contact the business, to customer-facing tools such as quote requests, online bookings, intake forms, and portals. We also build web applications that replace manual processes for staff. Projects are quoted after a scoping call at a fixed price with no hourly billing, and every project includes hosting setup, domain configuration, and handover with documentation.
projects: A marketing site for a Verde River outfitter with trip descriptions, pricing, and an online booking form that feeds the reservation calendar.
A quote request form for a roofing or HVAC contractor that collects the address, photos, and job details and creates the lead in the company's job system.
An online ordering page for a pecan farm or vineyard with wholesale and retail pricing and a pickup or shipping option.
A menu and reservation site for a restaurant that the owner can update without a developer.
A customer portal for a property manager where tenants submit maintenance requests and view their lease documents.
A staff-facing web application that replaces a paper intake form at a clinic or service counter.

faqs.q: How is a website project priced?
faqs.a: After a 20-minute scoping call, we quote a fixed price for the project. There is no hourly billing, and hosting setup and domain configuration are included.

faqs.q: What do we need to provide?
faqs.a: We need the services and prices the site should list, any photos or logo files, and access to the current domain registrar. If a booking or quote tool is part of the project, we also need the details of how those requests are handled today.

faqs.q: Can we update the site ourselves after handover?
faqs.a: Yes. Every project ends with a handover and written documentation so staff can update content, pricing, and hours without a developer.
